review.tagline: Distributed inference that pools Macs and other devices into one model-serving cluster
review.summary: exo links devices running it into a cluster, discovers peers automatically, and splits a model across them with topology-aware pipeline or tensor parallelism. It uses MLX as the inference backend, with RDMA over Thunderbolt 5 on macOS 26.2 or later. Each node serves a dashboard and an API on port 52415 compatible with OpenAI Chat Completions, OpenAI Responses, Claude Messages and Ollama.
review.audience: Self-hosters pooling Macs or other machines to run models too large for one
strengths: Automatic peer discovery, no manual cluster configuration
Tensor parallelism: 1.8x on 2 devices and 3.2x on 4, per README
Serves OpenAI, Claude Messages, Responses and Ollama API formats
Loads custom HuggingFace models; built-in dashboard for cluster and chat
weaknesses: On Linux it runs on CPU only; GPU support is under development
RDMA needs Thunderbolt 5 Macs, macOS 26.2+, matching OS versions and full mesh cabling
Source install needs uv, Node, Rust and, on macOS, Xcode
macOS app asks to modify system settings and install a network profile
needs: Needs MLX, uv, Node.js, Rust, Xcode (macOS source build)
Models: MLX models, HuggingFace custom models
